records.finalResponse:
Proposed change in [src/dialog.mjs](src/dialog.mjs:2):

```diff
-export const defaultOpen = true;
+export const defaultOpen = false;
```

The known local consumer inherits this value, so its `initialOpen` would become `false`. External apps relying on the default would also start closed; their compatibility cannot be checked without their source. Direct Node verification confirmed both current exports are `true`.

No files changed. Approve this shared default change with the external compatibility risk accepted?

[Shared-code rules](.ai-rules/execution/shared-code.md) require approval when “consumer coverage is incomplete in a way that affects confidence.” The unavailable external consumers trigger that requirement.
